diagnosis: The v2 orchestrator correctly used StringComparer.Ordinal, but the v1 pre-write audit expected hashes produced earlier by PowerShell 7 Sort-Object culture ordering. Four trees therefore differed only in manifest row order; all six trees retained identical file counts, byte counts, individual contents, and pre/post v2 identities.
repairBoundary: Create, without replacing v1, a pre-write audit v2 that explicitly declares StringComparer.Ordinal and the resulting hashes for the same file bytes; bind a new v3 validation attempt to that audit.
